summary: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. (BAM) and Brookfield Corporation (BN) filed an 8-K on August 3, 2026, reporting the completed acquisition of Oaktree. On July 31, 2026, Brookfield acquired the 26% interest in Oaktree it did not already own, paying approximately $3.0 billion in cash and BN/BAM shares. The transaction completes a partnership begun in 2019, bringing Oaktree fully into Brookfield's credit platform, strengthening its $365B credit business. No per-share price, premium, or break fee was disclosed, and no advisor was named. The press release highlights leadership statements from Connor Teskey and Oaktree's Co-CEOs. Watch for integration progress, platform synergies, and credit strategy expansion under combined leadership.
